challenges.description: Kick the Evil Chicken in the Champions Guild to death
Hit 16 with Water Strike
Cook 10 fish in 10 ticks using the 1 tick cooking method.
Mine a copper ore, iron ore and coal within 15 seconds. The time starts when you start mining your first rock.
Chop a normal log, oak log and willow log within 15 seconds. The time starts when you start chopping your first tree.
Complete the following action: Uzqf jo dibu J mpwf zpv Dibsep
Donate some gp to a poor tramp.
Interrupt a man on the toilet
Show proof of an NPC who knows the truth about Runescape being a video game
Find something nice
Take damage from swamp decay outside of Morytania
Lose the ability to teleport to Fossil Island from the Digsite Pendant
Speak to Hans whilst he is outside of the walls of Lumbridge Castle courtyard
Type in chat 'you rat' during Scurrius's death animation in a solo encounter
Stun a Tar Monster
Complete a pie task for Romily
Obtain a belt buckle
Retrieve some gold ore from Terry Bolando
Try to do something very silly
Take 28 damage from an explosion in Tzhaar City
Anger some barbarians by stealing beer from a barrel
Spy on the wizard's tower
Kill 3 imps in less than 6 seconds
Defeat a Tree Spirit in the Enchanted Valley using only Magic Secateurs
Show proof of the leprechaun who hates cabbages
Make your own imp repellant
Eat some mountain goat stew
Defeat the Shaihakan using a Karambwan tipped Hastae
Catch a Rainbow fish
Score a goal in Gnomeball. Once you obtain the ball from the coach you must only click once on the net and not move in any other way on the field.
Kill a Chaos Dwarf in Kandarin
Pop out of the hole in Yanille
Fish gives immense cover
Repel a mosquito swarm
Receive a cooked lobster from Askeladdon
Get free rope from Ned
Empty barrels of apples from the Lady Zay
Mine Red Topaz from a gem rock outside of Karamja
Obtain Shantay's Secret Ungathanki Kebab recipe
Catch a Salmon in the Desert
Find the spot potion
Rob 50 gold pieces from Klenter's Pyramid
Teleport a Jackal through a fairy ring
Set a Mummy on fire!
Attempt to catch a crypt rat using any type of cat
Show the dialogue of an NPC who wants to start an Onion Guild
Obtain the 3 Mort Myre Fungus drop from a single Swamp Crab
Defeat an Ent with a woodcutting axe
Spawn the Golum Goblin
Enter the Wilderness through a magic door
Speak to a Jagex Mod spoof in Tirannwn

Every day I sit by my telescope.
I watch the serpent fall.
My hand numb with injury.
Come and speak to me
Boogie with the knife wielding crab sporting a claw of it's kind
Blow a kiss to ''Abey alt ml mt''
Poison yourself from a Bird Bath

Complete the Varlamore only Barcrawl by obtaining and drinking these tipples: Cider, Beer, Wine, Beer Tankand, Rum, Whiskey, Vodka, Gin, Wizard Mindbomb, Dwarven Stout, Steamforge brew, Trapper's Tipple, Sunbeam Ale, Moon-lite, Sun-shine, Eclipse Wine. You must only obtain these in Varlamore
Show Nasty Nick the jolly side of life by wearing a red outfit and dancing a jig
Have your fish stolen by a naughty gull
Cook 28 fish in 28 ticks using the 1 tick cooking method.
Defeat Scurrius solo. You must not take any damage off prayer and can only attack using the last combat style he used.
Create a rainbow fire line using red logs, green logs, blue log, purple log and a regular coloured fire.
Kill 5 Armoured Zombies in 1:40 or less using only throwing axes
Obtain an Iron Halberd from a Gorak in the Gorak Plane
Defeat the Deranged Archeologist. You must not move out of his melee distance at any point during the fight.
Defeat Bryophyta using only woodcutting axes.
Complete a solo game of Volcanic Mine. You must achieve a minimum of 2,000 base points in a single game excluding the minigame point multiplier
Complete 3 Mahogany Homes Contracts in less than 4:30. You must not use Bankers Note or a Plank Sack

Defeat all of the Animated Armour types in the Warriors Guild. For each fight you must match the equipment that it is using and not have any other items equipped. You must kill all 7 in less than 3:30
Balance 5 barrels on your head
Get 3 Ornate Lockpicks from a single run of Camdozaal Vault

Enter the Giant Mole's lair. You must only bring a candle as a light source. Once it is extinguished, you may not relight it. You must kill the Giant Mole and escape without using any teleports. You may not use Banker's Note

Defeat the Giant Mole. You must stand in melee distance at all times when you are fighting it. You must have your protection prayer enabled the tick the mole attacks you. You must not lose any prayer points or take any damage.
Defeat the Giant Mole without it burrowing and whilst only using special attacks. You must not leave the lair once you start the fight.
Defeat a Greater Demon in Asgarnia using a yew shortbow and full blue dragonhide armour
Solo the Fishing Trawler. You must catch a minimum of 20 fish. The 50% boost from the Ardougne Elite diary does not count.

Kill a Brutal Green Dragon and a Mithril Dragon back to back without leaving the Ancient Cavern. You must be under the influence of a Drunk Dragon after every instance of damage you deal. You must not use Bankers Note
Heal at least 12 hitpoints using a single Castle Wars bandage
Equip the Merfolk Trident in front of the Kraken
Defeat a Black Demon using only Holy Water
Obtain a seed or a herb from a Sea Snake
Defeat the Dagannoth Kings. You must only attack and kill one at a time. All three must be defeated before the first one respawns
Dream in the hotel above an inn in a tropical village
Have somebody call you out for using NPC Contact
Defeat a Moss Giant in the Viyeldi Caves
Defeat a Rune Dragon. You must not wear insulated boots and must not take any damage from the electricity attacks
Harvest Goutweed from a herb patch
Defeat the Kalphite Queen. You may only use the combat style that she is praying against and you may not walk under, safespot or flinch
Have fish be firing from the cannon on both ships at the same time in a solo encounter at Tempoross
Complete a solo game of Guardians of the Rift. You must earn combined total of 750 contribution points with a minimum of 300 points in each.
Saviour the taste of giant's feet after defeating the mightiest Hill Giant of them all with the largest blade from their own kin

Complete a run of the summer garden in the Sorceress Garden. You must complete the maze in one click. There must not be anyone else in the maze and you must not use any of the Sorceress Garden plugins or set it up in advance
Complete a game of Trouble Brewing. You must be solo in your own team and brew 20 Rum during the game
Find the Gnome Skeleton in Morytania
Churn cheese from butter ''That's Totally Not Garlic!''
Complete a Hard Temple Trek. You must encounter Nail Beasts and you may only deal damage to these using a potion. You must not evade any encounters

Defeat the Chaos Elemental 3 times in a row. You must meet the following requirements:
- You may not safespot or flinch.
- You must have at least 1 empty inventory space at all times and may not add any items into your inventory other than for the Chaos Elemental's unequipping attack once you start the first kill.
- Once the Chaos Elemental has unequipped an item, you may not re-equip it and must free up an inventory space.
- You may not use any food that leaves behind an item such as a pie and you must have Vial Smasher enabled at the Sage.
Defeat the Chaos Fanatic using only Melee
Solo the Revenant Maledictus. You must not use any revenant weapons
Defeat the King Black Dragon without antifire protection
Show your respects to the dead by planting 20 flowers from Adamant Seeds in the Graveyard of Shadows
Defeat the Crazy Archeologist. You must not move out of his melee range at any point during the fight.
Defeat a Runite Golem in the Resource area using only a pickaxe. You do not need to mine the golem once defeated
Enter the Runecrafting Abyss, without being skulled.
Defeat the 'Rabbit'
Defeat Zalcano solo
Catch 35 red chinchompas (bonus chins from relics do not count towards this total) in the Gwenith Hunter area within 3 minutes. Time starts when you place down a trap.
Craft a full set of Black Dragonhide armour. You must obtain all raw materials without leaving Prifiddinas or Gwenith.
Defeat Skotizo using only melee and without using a Demonbane weapon.
Steal an Artefact and hand it to Captain Khaled. You may not run and must not have any Guards set up on the world
Find every book in the Arceuus Library within 3 minutes. The timer starts when you take the first book
Defeat 2 Lizardmen Shamens in Molch Temple. You may only use melee, can only pray range and must not take any melee damage or any damage from the purple spawns
Defeat a Lizardmen Shamen in the Lizardmen Canyon without equipping any Shayzian Armour pieces
Have all 4 braziers lit at the same time during a solo Wintertodt whilst it has less than 50% energy
Defeat Sarachnis with a full inventory of 28 newspapers
Obtain 25 Mithril Ore in 5 minutes at the Blast Mine
Defeat Bryophyta using only poison dynamite.
Obtain 5 Molch Pearls within 10 minutes
Aggress all of the Dust Devils in the larger room in the Catacombs of Kourend. Without killing any, show off your hair for 3 seconds before killing them all. You must not restore your stats
Grow 100 plants in Tithe Farm using the 25x4 method. You must not let any crops die. Extra fruit gathered from relics do not count towards the 100 plant total.

Catch 14 Pyre Foxes whilst listening to the song Ylvis - The Fox (What Does The Fox Say?). You must start the song prior to setting up your first Deadfall trap and must catch all 14 before the song finishes.
Complete 3 Hunter Contracts within 9 minutes
Fish a full inventory of Bream whilst constantly performing the 'Wiggle'. The 'Wiggle' is achieved by changing the direction that your character is facing in the stream after every tick.
Loot all six individual chests in the Aldarin Villas in less than 3 minutes
Defeat Amoxliatl. You must not take any damage and must not have your protection prayers enabled for more than one consecetive tick.
Defeat Amoxliatl. Every time it does the Icicle Crash attack, you must cast a fire spell before the attack hits you. You must not take any damage.
Defeat a Perilious Moon. Every time you start to take damage from the moon you must negate the third hitsplat.
Find a nasty surprise
Complete the first Jad Challenge, the second Jad Challenge and the third Jad Challenge in a row without failure
Complete the third Jad Challenge. You must stand in melee distance of the Jad before you can attack it.

Claim 10 Agility Tickets in a row without missing one. The additional tickets claimed from the Elite Karamja diary do not count towards this total. With your compass set to North, you may only move horizontally until you are aligned with the target pillar then you can only move vertically
Defeat the Soul Wars Avatar. You must be the only person on your team and must stand in melee distance of the Avatar at all times during the fight. You must not use Banker's Note

Defeat 3 Tormented Demons at the same time. You must kill one Tormented demon using melee demonbane, one using Scorching Bow and the other using the Purging Staff. You must get every tormented demon down to less than 5% hitpoints before you can finish any of them off. You must not hide behind walls or use any tactic to cheese.
Defeat 3 Cerberus in a single trip without using prayer. You must let him summon souls at least once in every fight and you must not use Bankers Note to resupply or cheese the souls to avoid damage

Defeat Cerberus. You must not have your protection prayers enabled for more than one consecetive tick. You must let him summon souls at least twice during the fight. You must not take any damage by the souls

Defeat Kreeara. You may only use chinchompas and you may only directly attack the bodyguards. You must change the bodyguard you are attacking after every throw and must target them in this order: Melee Minion, Magic Minion, Range Minion. Once a minion dies you must wait for it to respawn the next time you are due to hit that minion.

Defeat Commander Zilyana. You may only use chinchompas and you may only directly attack the bodyguards. You must change the bodyguard you are attacking after every throw and must target them in this order: Melee Minion, Magic Minion, Range Minion. Once a minion dies you must wait for it to respawn the next time you are due to hit that minion.
Defeat the Whisperer. You must not move diagonally or in an L shape. You must not take any damage from the Shadow Tentacles
Burn an oomlie wrap
Defeat the Kraken using only range attacks
Obtain the perfect score of 1,000 in a game of Archery at the Ranging Guild
Defeat Glough. Every attack you must change combat styles and you must attack in this order: Melee, Magic, Range. You must then repeat the cycle
Talk to the Monkey Minder in the Ardougne Zoo whilst wearing a Maniacial Monkey Backpack
Defeat Dagannoth Rex 2 times. You must be under attack by Dagannoth Prime and Supreme at all times and must not kill them. You must not take any damage off prayer
Defeat all Dagannoth Kings at the same time using the bouncing effect of the Venator Bow
Defeat the Phantom Muspah. You must only use melee. You must not run and must complete a perfect kill
Defeat the Phantom Muspah. You must not use any prayer draining attacks during its shield phase and must complete a perfect kill
Defeat Duke Sucellus. You must not use Arder-musca poison to wake him up.
Poison a Turoth
Defeat the Abyssal Sire using only Shadow spells.

Defeat Akkha solo in the Tombs of Amascut Expert Mode. After each shadow becomes vulnerable you must DPS skip it once before you can finish it off. You must not take any damage from the shadows special attack.
Defeat Zebak solo in the Tombs of Amascut Expert Mode. During waves, you must not pass through waves by going through the safe gap.
Defeat Kephri solo in the Tombs of Amascut Expert Mode. You must have all Kephri invocations enabled and must not kill any Spitting or Soldier scarabs. You must not use Banker's Note
Defeat the Kalphite Queen. The only items you may use are items that were available before the 7th September 2004. You must not use Banker's Note
Defeat the Echo Kalphite Queen. You must not take any avoidable damage. You must not use Banker's Note
Defeat Araxxor. You must not directly damage the boss in any way during its enrage phase or take damage directly from Araxxor or venom pools during the enrage phase.
Defeat Arraxor with a full inventory of 28 newspapers

Complete all 5 floors of the Hallowed Sepulchre whilst listenening to Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up on loop. You must complete the 5th floor before the song has fully completed twice and you must not make any mistakes.

Complete a Barrows Run. You must not use any prayer or food throughout the entire run. You must only use barrows equipment that matches the brother that you are fighting eg Dharoks set against Dharok, Karils Set against Karil etc. You may not have any items equipped in any other slot.
Build up the Morton Temple and reach 100% sanctity. The whole process must be completed solo
Complete a game of Skullball in less than 1:45
Complete the Theatre of Blood: Story Mode solo. In a single run, you must meet the requirements for enough Combat Achievements to earn 25 CA points
Defeat Spindel and Venenatis solo back to back with a full inventory of 28 newspapers. You must not leave the Wilderness, reheal or reboost once you start the first fight
Defeat Vetion. You must skip the skeletal hellhounds in at least one of his two phases

Defeat Callisto. You must have the Tileman plugin enabled. After each attack you must move to a different tile. You must not take any damage from bear traps or step on any tiles you have already stood on
Defeat the Corporeal Beast. You may not use the Osmuntens Fang or use any stat draining attacks. You may only use supplies that you can hold within a single inventory and must not use Bankers Note
Defeat 5 Abyssal Demons in a row without it teleporting you or itself
Defeat the King Black Dragon. The only items you may use are items that were available in Runescape Classic. You must not use Banker's Note
Defeat Zulrah in all 4 rotations whilst meeting the requiirements for the ''Perfect Zulrah'' CA task.
Defeat Zulrah after reaching her random hidden phase
Defeat Zalcano solo using only a Bronze Pickaxe
Defeat the Fragment of Seren without using Magic
Defeat the ''Rabbit''. You must not move, freeze or stun. You may not use prayer and you must not leave the dungeon once you have started the fight. You must not use Banker's Note
Catch three Crystal Implings in less than 90 seconds.
Catch the Crystal Impling who's name resembles a Family Guy character
Defeat the Corrupted Hunllef. You must not reveal more than 12 rooms. The starting room and the boss room count towards this total
Defeat the Corrupted Hunlief. You must reveal every room and must prepare full T2 armour and 24 fish
Defeat the Crystalline Hunllef without any armour and without using any supplies.

Defeat Vanguards solo in Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode without dying or leaving the room. You must attack a different Vanguard after every attack and must not let them reset. You must not use Banker's Note or suicide supplies into the room

Defeat Vespula solo in Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode without dying or leaving the room. You must not use the redemption method or phoenix necklaces. You must not use Banker's Note or suicide supplies into the room

Defeat the Ice Demon solo in Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode. After every Ice Domon attack, you must switch between the Protect from Range and Protect from Magic prayer so that it switches its attack type each time. You must not take any damage from any of the Ice Demon's attacks

Defeat the Lizardman Shamen's solo in Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode. With the aggression of every Lizardman Shamen in the room at all times and without safespotting or equipping any Shayzian Armour pieces, kill every Lizardman Shamen without taking any damage.

Defeat the Alchemical Hydra. During enrage phase, you must change your combat style after every attack. You must attack the Hydra at the same speed as it attacks you and you must not fail to attack. You must not take damage off prayer
Defeat Sarachnis. Every time you are stunned, you must perform the Ring of Stone tech. You must perform this tick perfect every time. You must not use Arenea Boots.

Defeat the Mimic. You must not move during the fight and after every candy attack you must consume a purple sweet. You may only deal damage to the Mimic using special attacks. You may not use Banker's Note
Defeat a Moons of Peril. You must not stand or attack on the coloured moon at any point. You may not attack during the Eclipse Moons Clone phase
Complete a full Perilious Moons run. You must not use melee against any of the moons
Defeat the Hueycoatl solo. You must use melee and must only use Jugs of Wine as food. You must not restore your stats or use Rapid Restore prayer
Earn a perfect streak of 3 kills only soloing the Hueycoatl. You must not leave the instance, resupply or use Banker's Note
Defeat Sol Heredit. Every time he targets an item in your worn inventory, you must unequip it for the rest of the fight.
Convert Dragon Claws into an Egg
Complete an Inferno without hiding behind any pillars. You must not use Banker's Note
Complete the Inferno. You must only attack each Jal-MejJak once and must not kill any. You cannot use the redemption prayer, phoenix necklaces or Bankers Note.

Complete the Fight Caves and Inferno back to back without banking or changing your gear/resupplying in any way. Your inventory and worn equipment must not exceed a GE value of more than 500k. The GE value of any raw material used for an untradeable item or any items held within containers counts towards this total. Echo items cannot be used. You must not use Bankers Note.
Complete the Fight Caves without using Prayer. You must not use Banker's Note
Complete the 6th Jad Challenge. You must not kill any healers

Defeat three Tormented Demons at the same time. The only method of damage you are allowed is off shield using Elemental spells, Heavy Ranged or Crush weapons. You must not use any thralls or status effects to deal damage. You must meet the requirements for the CA task ''Three Times The Thrashing''
Complete the 6th Jad Challenge. You must use a different godsword for each Jad and only damage Jad and its healers with that godsword. The Dogsword is included as the 6th godsword for this challenge.

Defeat General Graardor without being hit by him or his bodyguards. You must cap your maximum hit at 25 and you must not use any tile markers or any references which shows you the correct tiles to stand. You must not use anything that can freeze his movement.

Defeat Commander Zilyana without being hit by her or her bodyguards. You must cap your maximum hit at 25 and you must not use any tile markers or any references which shows you the correct tiles to stand. You must not use anything that can freeze her movement

Defeat K'ril Tsutsaroth without being hit by him or his bodyguards. You must cap your maximum hit at 25 and you must not use any tile markers or any references which shows you the correct tiles to stand. You can not use anything that can freeze his movement.
Defeat Nex Solo. You must not use Banker's Note

Defeat the Whisperer. You must only cast spells from the Standard Magic spellbook. You must manually cast each spell in this order. Air -> Earth -> Fire -> Water. You must then repeat the cycle throughout the kill. Once you reach the enraged phase, you must reverse this order so its Water -> Fire -> Earth -> Air. You must not take any damage off prayer.
Defeat the Awakened Whisperer. You must not move diagonally or in an L shape. You must not take any damage from the Shadow Tentacles
Defeat three Demonic Gorillas at the same time. You must not take any damage and all three demonic gorillas must be killed in consecutive hits
Defeat the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil. You must not use prayer and must be under attack by every single Smoke Devil in the boss room

Defeat the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil. At the start of the fight you must take off your facemask/slayer helmet to have your stats reduced. Immediately re-equip and then without restoring your stats or enabling any prayers you must then finish the fight without using Banker's Note
Defeat Vorkath. You must have the Tileman plugin enabled and must not step on a tile you have already stood on. You must move 2 tiles between every attack
Defeat the Phantom Muspah. You must only use melee. You must only walk and may only move in a diagonal direction. Every 2 tiles you must change direction. You must complete a perfect kill

Defeat Dagannoth Rex 3 times. You must be under attack by Dagannoth Prime and Supreme at all times and must not kill them. You must not take any damage off prayer. Every time you lose a prayer point, you must stop attacking and restore the prayer point immediately using a Jangerberry before you can attack. You may bring no more than 5 Jangerberries with you and you must not restore prayer in any other way.
Defeat the Leviathan. You must set your display to black and white mode via your Graphics Card settings and you must not take any damage off prayer

Defeat Zebak solo at Path Level 4 or higher in a 600 Raid Level TOA or higher. All Zebak invocations and Hardcore Deaths must be enabled and Blazing Tombs 2 invocation must not be enabled. Your protect from range and protect from magic prayers must be located on the opposite diagonal corners of your prayer book. You must not take any damage off prayer

Defeat Zebak solo at Path Level 4 or Higher in a 600 Raid Level TOA or higher. All Zebak invocations and Hardcore Deaths must be enabled and Blazing Tombs 2 invocation must not be enabled. You must only use melee and you must move tiles every single tick that you are not able to attack and cannot move back to any tile you was standing on, over the last 6 ticks. You must not take any damage off prayer.

Defeat Kephri solo at Path Level 4 or higher in a 600 Raid Level TOA or higher. All Kephri invocations except for Medic must be enabled and no Blazing Tombs invocation must be enabled. You must fill the room with at least 180 tiles of dung before killing it.

Complete the Tombs of Amascut at 400 RL+ solo. You must not bring any of your own supplies or use any supplies provided by the ghost. The Overly Draining, Deadly Prayers, Silent Prayers, Hardcore Deaths invocations must be enabled and no Blazing Tombs invocations must be enabled.

Defeat Akkha solo at Path Level 4 or higher in a 600 Raid Level TOA or higher. You must have Feeling Special, Double Trouble and Hardcore Deaths enabled and Blazing Tombs 2 invocation must not be enabled. You must stay within a single quadrant during Simon Says and not cross over into any other quadrant. You must not take any damage.

Defeat Baba solo at Path Level 4 or higher in a 600 Raid Level TOA or higher. You must have Mind the Gap and Hardcore Deaths enabled and Blazing Tombs 2 invocation must not be enabled. You must stand in the central segment of the room at all times. The only exceptions to this rule are that you may only cross to the sides of the room for a single tick before Baba pushes you before the rolling boulders phase and for a single tick to dodge the boulder smash attack and only if there is no rocks in the centre for you to use.

Defeat the Wardens solo in a 700 Raid Level TOA raid or higher. You must have Insanity and Hardcore Deaths enabled and must not have Blazing Tombs 2 invocation enabled. You must not attack or target any skulls during P3

Defeat the Echo Kalphite Queen. The only items you are allowed to use are items that were available before the 7th September 2004. You must not take any avoidable damage. You must not use Banker's Note
Solo the Theatre of Blood: Normal Mode. You must not use Banker's Note
Reach and beat the Nylocas room in HM Theatre of Blood solo raid. You must meet the requirements for the Perfect Nylocas CA task
Defeat Araxxor without using Melee. You must not stand in Araxxor's melee distance at any point during the fight. You must not use Banker's Note
Defeat Araxxor 5 times in one trip. You must not use any form of antipoison or antivenom and use any items that provide an immunity to poison/venom. You may not use Bankers Note.
Complete 5 Barrows runs in a row without taking any damage from any brother, monster in the tunnels or by the falling rocks after you loot the chest.
Defeat Callisto. You must stand in his melee distance and cannot freeze it

Defeat every single boss monster in the Wilderness abiding by the following restrictions:
- You must use a single inventory, without using Banker's Note or a looting bag.
- You must only use one weapon throughout your entire run and you must only deal damage using that weapon.
- Revenant weapons must not be used.
- You forfeit the run if you die or leave the Wilderness at any point. Going to Ferox Enclave or Mage Arena Bank counts as leaving the Wilderness for the purposes of this Challenge.
- King Black Dragon and Corporeal Beast count as Wilderness bosses for the purpose of this challenge

Defeat the Corrupted Gauntlet. You may only use 1 Tier 1 weapon and your fist. You may not equip any higher than T1 armour and you may not use the 5:1 method. You must meet the requirements for the CA task ''Perfect Corrupted Hunllef''
Defeat the Corrupted Gauntlet. You may only walk and must not lose any ticks when attacking the Hunlief. You must use melee as one of your combat styles

Defeat the Corrupted Gauntlet. You must use melee as one of your combat styles. You must only move in diagonal lines and must not walk. You must meet the requirements for the CA task ''Perfect Corrupted Hunllef''
Complete the Priffddinas Agility Course in 1:03.60 or less

Defeat Tekton solo in Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode without dying or leaving the room. You may not use Osmumtens Fang or any stat draining attacks. You must not use Banker's Note or suicide supplies into the room.
Defeat Guardians solo in Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode. You must defeat both using only a bronze pickaxe and no DWH specs. You must not take any damage

Complete a solo run of the Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode. You must only use items and spells that were available during the Twisted League. You must not use any raid uniques nor use the Rigour or Augury prayer

Defeat Great Olm solo in Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode without dying. You must not use melee on the melee hand, magic on the magic hand or use range on the head. You must not use Banker's Note or suicide supplies into the room
Defeat Alchemical Hydra. You must not weaken it using any of the pools and must not take any damage

Defeat the Alchemical Hydra using only Magic. You must have the Cursed Amulet of Magic equipped at all times and no other magic damage % altering items. You must meet the requirements for the CA task ''Alcleanical Hydra''
Defeat the Mimic using only a Third Age weapon as a source of damage
Defeat Sol Heredit without using melee.

Complete a full run of the Fortis Colloseum. You must only use melee and must have Bees and Totemic enabled at the earliest opportunity. Whenever you get an opportunity to upgrade one of the other, you must take it. You must complete the full run without taking any damage from Bees.
Complete a full Perilious Moons run. You must have a negative defence stat in stab, slash, and crush. You may not resupply once you start the first Moon or use Bankers Note.

Defeat Vardorvis. You must start with a Rune Scimitar and must swap to the following weapons at the following hp thresholds: 80% hp -> Adamant Scimitar, 60% hp Mithril Scimitar -> 40% hp Steel Scimitar and 20% hp -> Iron Scimitar. You must deal the final blow using a Bronze Scimitar.
Defeat Vardorvis. Every time the head attacks you, you must manually cast a spell. The spell must hit Vardorvis before the head's attack hits you. You must not take any damage from Vardorvis's head.
Complete the 6th Jad Challenge and the League only Jad Challenge in a row without failure
Complete the 6th Jad Challenge without losing a prayer point and with the in game sounds turned off.
Complete the Fight Caves without taking any damage

Complete an Inferno without hiding behind any pillars. You must not let your prayer points go below 98 at any point throughout the run. You may only restore your prayer points twice and you cannot boost your prayer above 99. You must only attack each Jal-MejJak once and must not kill any. You must not kill Jad during Zuk. You must not let your hitpoints fall below 20 at any point during Zuk. You must not use Banker's Note
Complete the Inferno. Throughout the entire run, you must only move [2,1] or [1,2] tiles in a single tick whereas your movement resembles a Knight in Chess. You must not use Banker's Note
Complete the Inferno two times in a row in less than 1 hour. Time spent resupplying in between runs counts towards this time.

Defeat the Awakened Whisperer. You must only cast spells from the Standard Magic spellbook. You must manually cast each spell in this order. Air -> Earth -> Fire -> Water. You must then repeat the cycle throughout the kill. Once you reach the enraged phase, you must reverse this order so its Water -> Fire -> Earth -> Air. You must not take any damage off prayer.
Defeat the Awakened Whisperer. If you have the melee relic, you must only use melee. Otherwise you must only deal damage whilst in melee distance. You must not use Banker's Note
Defeat Phantom Muspah. You must complete the CA tasks ''Phantom Muspah Manipulator'' and 'More than a ranged weapon'' in the same kill.
Defeat the Awakened Duke Sucellus. You must attack on the same tick that Duke attacks each time and not miss any attacks you could have gotten. You must get a perfect kill.

Defeat the Awakened Leviathan. You must set your display to black and white mode via your Graphics Card settings and you must not take any damage off prayer. You must go through at least two rotations of regular attacks in between stunning with Shadow Spells.
Defeat the Awakened Leviathan. You must not cast any Shadow spells. You must not use Banker's Note
Solo a 1000 Raid Level Tombs of Amascut. You must not use Banker's Note

Defeat Akkha solo at Path level 4 or higher in an 700 Raid Level TOA raid or higher. You must have all Akkha invocations and Hardcore Deaths enabled and you must not have Blazing Tombs 2 invocation enabled. You must have your camera spinning in one direction at all times throughout the fight and must not take any unneccessary damage.

Defeat the Elidinis Warden (The Warden which summons Akkha and Kephri) solo in a 700 Raid Level TOA or higher. You must have all Warden invocations, Aerial Assault, Dehydration, On a Diet and Hardcore Deaths enabled and Blazing Tombs 2 invocation must not be enabled. At the start of P3 Wardens, you must enable the Blindfold plugin. The Blindfold plugin should have show UI turned on and all other checkboxes disabled. You must keep the plugin on until the raid is completed. You must not use tile markers, NPC indicators or any other method of getting around the restriction.

Complete a full run of the Tombs of Amascut in a 700 Raid Level or higher. You must have all boss invocations enabled and must not have Blazing Tombs 2 Invocation enabled. You must meet the requirements of ''Perfection of Crondis'', ''Perfection of Apmeken'', ''Perfection of Het'', ''Perfection of Scabras'' and ''Perfect Wardens'' in a single run.
Solo the Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode. You must not use Banker's Note
Complete a Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode. You must meet the requirements for the Perfect Theatre CA task

Solo the Theatre of Blood: Normal Mode. You must meet the requirements for the Morytania Only CA Task and nobody must use any items or cast any spells that cannot be obtained on a Morytania locked account. You must not use Banker's Note
Complete all 5 floors of the Hallowed Sepulchre in 5:30 or less
Defeat the Phosani's Nightmare. You must not lose a single prayer point and must not take any unneccesary damage.

Defeat the Phosani's Nightmare. You may only deal damage using a swamp lizard and you must not take any unneccessary damage. The weapon restriction does not apply to Husks, Parasites and Sleepwalkers. You must not use Bankers Note

Defeat Venenatis solo. You must convert each character of the phrase NEWSPEPER ENTHUSIEST into a number respective to its position in the traditional alphabet. You must then attack exactly that number of ticks later after your previous attack. Once you reach the end of the phrase you must repeat from the first character.
Complete the Corrupted Gauntlet 3 times in a row in less than 5:45

Defeat the Corrupted Gauntlet. You must only use 1 T1 weapon and your fist and do not use the 5:1 method. You must meet the requirements for the following CA tasks in a single kill: Wolf Puncher II, Defence Doesn't Matter II, Egniol Diet II and Perfect Corrupted Hunllef.
Defeat the Corrupted Gauntlet. After every Hunlef attack you must type into the chat the next number of the Fibonacci sequence. You must complete a perfect kill.
Complete the Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode solo. You must scale the raid to the 1 + 24 with Captain Rimor and must meet the requirements for Perfect Olm (solo)
Complete a solo run of Chambers of Xeric in less than 10 minutes
Complete the Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode solo. You may not use any of your own supplies or use any supplies provided within the raid

Defeat the Alchemical Hydra. You must attack the Hydra the same tick that the Hydra attacks you and you must use the same combat style as the Hydra at all times throughout the fight. You must not fail to attack the Hydra at any point. You must meet the requirements for the CA task ''Alcleanical Hydra''
Defeat Sol Heredit. You must not hide behind any pillar at any point throughout the Colloseum run. You must not use Banker's Note
Complete the Fortis Colloseum in less than 10 minutes

Defeat Sol Heredit. Once you spawn in, you must drop items around the room. You must not drop any more than 2 items per column or per row. Once you attack Sol for the first time, you must not move diagonally or in an L shape and you must only move using a Red X action. You must not drop any further items, take any damage and you must not use Banker's Note.

Defeat Sol Heredit. When the fight starts, you must enable the Blindfold plugin. The Blindfold plugin should have show UI turned on and all other checkboxes disabled. You must not use tile markers, NPC indicators or any other method to get around the restriction. Whilst having Doom 2 enabled, you must not take any more than 6 instances of damage. If you take more than 2 instances of damage in the same or in a consecutive tick, that will only count as 1 instance of damage. You must not use Banker's Note.
Defeat the Awakened Vardorvis. You must meet the requirements for the CA task ''Axe Enthusiast''. You must not use Banker's Note

Defeat the Awakened Vardorvis. Your inventory and worn equipment must not exceed a GE value of 100k going into the fight. Echo items cannot be used. You must abide by the following restrictions:
- You must only deal damage via one of the following sources: Blisterwood Flail, Silver Bolts (with a Rune Crossbow or lower), Earth spells (Wave or lower) with Ivandis Flail and Tome of Earth equipped. For Magic users the price of the Tome of Earth and runes are exempt from the total
- The GE value of any raw material used for an untradeable item or any items held within containers counts towards this total.
- You must not use Banker's Note
- The value of the Awakened Orb does not count towards this total
